### Economía aplicada

Groups: 6 · Skills: 18

[appliedEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/appliedEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specialized markets and institutional conditions in cities, housing, transport, education, healthcare, and agriculture create distinct economic mechanisms. This domain examines sector-specific choices and consequences without duplicating geographic, medical, educational, or agricultural competencies.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo se aplican los principios económicos a ciudades, vivienda, transporte, educación, salud y agricultura.

#### Economía agrícola

Skills: 3

[agriculturalEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/agriculturalEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Biological cycles, uncertain weather, land use, and international exchange shape agricultural markets.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué la agricultura tiene costos y riesgos particulares.

##### Mercados agrícolas

[agriculturalMarkets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalMarkets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze farm-product prices in light of seasonality, storage opportunities, harvest variations, and international trade.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué los precios de los alimentos varían con las estaciones, las cosechas y el comercio.

##### Estacionalidad y riesgos agrícolas

[agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/agriculturalSeasonalityAndRisk.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how seasonal cycles, weather shocks, and variable costs influence production and options for insurance or hedging.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo los agricultores manejan la incertidumbre estacional y los riesgos climáticos.

##### Seguridad alimentaria como problema económico

[foodSecurityAsAnEconomicIssue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/skills/foodSecurityAsAnEconomicIssue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze physical and economic access to food, stability of supplies, and why sufficient aggregate production does not ensure everyone can obtain food.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué producir suficientes alimentos no significa que todos puedan comprarlos o acceder a ellos.

#### Economía de la educación

Skills: 3

[economicsOfEducation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/economicsOfEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Investing in knowledge creates private and social returns and raises questions of financing, access, and uncertain information.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora los beneficios, los costos y la financiación de la educación.

##### Desigualdad económica en la educación

[economicInequalityInEducation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/economicInequalityInEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how household income, local resources, institutions, and information shape learning opportunities and later economic outcomes.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué las familias y comunidades no tienen las mismas oportunidades educativas.

##### Rendimientos económicos de la educación

[economicReturnsToEducation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/economicReturnsToEducation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess expected changes in earnings, productivity, and opportunity relative to time and schooling costs without automatically interpreting an education–earnings correlation as causal.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara el valor económico de la educación con sus costos de tiempo y dinero.

##### Financiación de la educación

[educationFinancing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/economicsOfEducation/skills/educationFinancing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare private and public financing of education by cost distribution, access, and incentives.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora quién paga la educación y cómo las decisiones de financiación afectan el acceso.

#### Economía de la salud

Skills: 3

[healthEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/healthEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Healthcare markets involve substantial information asymmetry, insurance arrangements, and external effects of population health.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué los mercados de atención sanitaria funcionan de otra forma que los de bienes comunes.

##### Seguro médico y riesgo moral

[healthInsuranceAndMoralHazard.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthInsuranceAndMoralHazard.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how insurance coverage changes the allocation of costs and incentives to use services without labeling all care-seeking as undesirable behavior.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo un seguro puede cambiar quién paga y cómo se utilizan los servicios.

##### Financiación de la atención sanitaria

[healthcareFinancing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthcareFinancing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare tax-based, insurance-based, and direct payment by access, household financial risk, and system costs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara distintas formas de financiar la atención sanitaria.

##### Mercados de servicios sanitarios

[healthcareServiceMarkets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/healthEconomics/skills/healthcareServiceMarkets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze interactions among patients, clinicians, insurers, and facilities under unequal access to information, prices, and service quality.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué comprar atención sanitaria implica información e incentivos complejos.

#### Vivienda y bienes inmuebles

Skills: 3

[housingAndRealEstate.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/housingAndRealEstate.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Housing prices and affordability depend on land, construction, income, mortgage finance, local demand, and regulation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué los precios de las viviendas y los alquileres varían según el lugar.

##### Asequibilidad de la vivienda

[housingAffordability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/housingAffordability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare purchase or rental expenses with income, debts, quality, and location; distinguish affordability from market price alone.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre qué hace que una vivienda sea asequible para un hogar determinado.

##### Mercado de la vivienda

[housingMarket.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/housingMarket.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze rents and house prices in relation to local demand, available supply, construction lead times, and financing.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la oferta y la demanda locales influyen en los precios de las viviendas.

##### Economía del uso del suelo

[landUseEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/housingAndRealEstate/skills/landUseEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how zoning, development limits, and alternative uses of land affect rents, construction volumes, and the location of activity.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo las normas del uso del suelo influyen en dónde y qué se construye.

#### Transporte e infraestructura

Skills: 3

[transportAndInfrastructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/transportAndInfrastructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving people and goods creates direct and external costs, while infrastructure requires large initial investments and lasts for long periods.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las decisiones económicas y sus compensaciones en transporte e infraestructura pública.

##### Economía de la congestión vial

[congestionEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/congestionEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the external costs of adding a user to a congested network and compare pricing or demand-management responses.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué un vehículo adicional puede ralentizar a los demás.

##### Evaluación de inversiones en infraestructura

[infrastructureInvestmentAppraisal.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/infrastructureInvestmentAppraisal.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare upfront and long-term project costs with travel-time savings, accessibility, and other social outcomes over a specified horizon.

**User-friendly description (es):** Evalúa si los beneficios de un proyecto de transporte justifican todos sus costos.

##### Demanda de transporte

[transportDemand.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/skills/transportDemand.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how fare or price, travel time, frequency, reliability, and available alternatives affect choice of travel mode.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora qué hace que las personas elijan un medio de transporte en lugar de otro.

#### Economía urbana y regional

Skills: 3

[urbanAndRegionalEconomics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Concentrations of people and firms yield benefits from proximity, infrastructure constraints, and regional specialization.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué las ciudades y regiones desarrollan distintas fortalezas económicas.

##### Efectos de aglomeración

[agglomerationEffects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/agglomerationEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain benefits and costs of concentrating firms and workers in cities through knowledge exchange, shared resources, congestion, and land prices.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué concentrar empresas puede elevar la productividad, pero también los costos.

##### Disparidades económicas regionales

[regionalEconomicDisparities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/regionalEconomicDisparities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare territories' productivity, incomes, access to jobs, and infrastructure, distinguishing indicator levels from geographical location alone.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara las oportunidades económicas de distintas regiones mediante indicadores pertinentes.

##### Especialización regional

[regionalSpecialization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/urbanAndRegionalEconomics/skills/regionalSpecialization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze why different territories concentrate particular activities because of resource access, markets, human capital, and institutions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué distintas regiones se concentran en industrias diferentes.

### Comportamiento del consumidor

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[consumerBehavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consumers evaluate needs, quality, alternatives, and information under varying incomes and psychological constraints. This domain analyzes their choices rather than sellers' methods of promoting goods.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo deciden las personas qué comprar y qué información influye en ellas.

#### Factores conductuales de elección

Skills: 4

[behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/behavioralFactorsInChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limited attention and rationality, time preferences, presentation formats, and defaults can alter economic choices even when the formal options are unchanged.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo la presentación de alternativas influye en las decisiones.

##### Racionalidad limitada

[boundedRationality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/boundedRationality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how limits of time, knowledge, or computational ability lead decision-makers to use simplified rules.

**User-friendly description (es):** Observa por qué solemos usar atajos en vez de comparar todas las opciones.

##### Arquitectura de elección

[choiceArchitecture.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/choiceArchitecture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how default options, presentation order, and the difficulty of opting out affect choices without changing the underlying alternatives.

**User-friendly description (es):** Observa cómo las opciones predeterminadas y su disposición pueden orientar una decisión.

##### Efecto de encuadre

[framingEffect.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/framingEffect.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how equivalent information framed as gains or losses can change the assessment of a choice.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué los mismos datos se perciben distinto como ganancias o pérdidas.

##### Sesgo del presente

[presentBias.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/skills/presentBias.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize systematic overvaluation of immediate benefits relative to delayed consequences.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué una recompensa inmediata puede pesar más que un mejor resultado futuro.

#### Información y derechos del consumidor

Skills: 4

[consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/consumerInformationAndRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound consumer decisions depend not only on price but also on product information, contract terms, and possible protections.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende cómo la información y los derechos afectan las decisiones de compra.

##### Derechos y responsabilidades del consumidor

[consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret warranties, returns, and buyer and seller obligations in the applicable legal context.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce los derechos y deberes que acompañan a una compra.

##### Calidad de la información al consumidor

[qualityOfConsumerInformation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/qualityOfConsumerInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the origin, timeliness, and evidence supporting claims about goods and services, including review independence, rating representativeness, and sources' commercial interests.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprueba si las afirmaciones, calificaciones y reseñas de productos son fiables.

##### Costo total de compra

[totalCostOfPurchase.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/totalCostOfPurchase.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Estimate all substantial buyer-side costs, including delivery, operation, maintenance, and fees, when comparing options, even when these costs are disclosed. Seller-imposed optional extras belong to commercial-practices analysis.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara el costo real completo de una compra, no solo el precio anunciado.

##### Precio por unidad

[unitPricing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/skills/unitPricing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convert offer prices into comparable units of mass, volume, or quantity while accounting for bundle contents, quality, and promotional conditions; a cheaper package need not have a cheaper unit price.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara productos calculando el costo de cada unidad.

#### Necesidades y preferencias

Skills: 5

[needsAndPreferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/needsAndPreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal goals and preferences explain why identical goods need not have identical value for different buyers.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué diferentes personas valoran de distintas formas productos y experiencias.

##### Elección del consumidor con presupuesto limitado

[consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare affordable bundles of goods and services according to preferences, income, and prices; apply the consumer budget constraint without treating it as the full model of all resource constraints.

**User-friendly description (es):** Elige entre productos disponibles cuando ingresos y precios restringen las opciones.

##### Preferencias del consumidor

[consumerPreferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/consumerPreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how an individual ranks alternative bundles of goods and services according to their own priorities.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara cómo alguien ordena distintas combinaciones de bienes.

##### Utilidad marginal

[marginalUtility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/marginalUtility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the change in utility from consuming an additional unit with relevant conditions held constant; distinguish it from total utility.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cuánto valor añade para ti una unidad adicional.

##### Necesidades y deseos

[needsAndWants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/needsAndWants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish what is necessary for a specified goal or living conditions from additional preferences without imposing a universal list of desires.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue entre necesidades y deseos en una situación concreta.

##### Utilidad

[utility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/skills/utility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret utility as a model of an individual's preferences and valuation of consumption alternatives without assuming an objective universal unit of satisfaction.

**User-friendly description (es):** Entiende la utilidad como una forma de describir lo que alguien valora.

### Desarrollo, bienestar e instituciones

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Long-term differences between countries and population groups arise from productivity, distribution of resources, and rules of social interaction. Growth does not necessarily improve everyone's living conditions equally.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora por qué la riqueza, las oportunidades y la calidad de vida varían entre sociedades.

Skills: 4

[inequality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/inequality.data.ts)

[giniCoefficient.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/giniCoefficient.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a summary index of inequality and its limits in describing the shape of a distribution.

**User-friendly description (es):** Interpreta un coeficiente de Gini sin asumir que lo explica todo.

[incomeDistribution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/incomeDistribution.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara cómo se distribuyen los ingresos entre distintos grupos.

[intergenerationalEconomicMobility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/intergenerationalEconomicMobility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the relationship between parents' economic position and the opportunities available to the next generation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo las circunstancias familiares influyen en las oportunidades futuras.

##### Distribución de la riqueza

[wealthDistribution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/skills/wealthDistribution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze inequality in household net assets—property and financial claims less debt—separately from current income flows.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue la desigualdad de riqueza de la desigualdad de ingresos.

Skills: 3

[institutionsAndDevelopment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/institutionsAndDevelopment.data.ts)

[accessToFinanceAndBasicServices.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/accessToFinanceAndBasicServices.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the economic effects of access to infrastructure, payment systems, education, and health services.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo los servicios esenciales afectan las oportunidades económicas de las personas.

##### Corrupción e incentivos económicos

[corruptionAndEconomicIncentives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/corruptionAndEconomicIncentives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how unofficial payments and selective rule enforcement influence costs and competition.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo la corrupción distorsiona las decisiones empresariales y la competencia.

##### Instituciones económicas inclusivas

[inclusiveEconomicInstitutions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/institutionsAndDevelopment/skills/inclusiveEconomicInstitutions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether rules permit participation in economic life and protect people from arbitrary appropriation of resources.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce cómo el acceso justo y los derechos protegidos amplían las oportunidades económicas.

#### Pobreza y bienestar

Skills: 3

[povertyAndWellbeing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/povertyAndWellbeing.data.ts)

[humanDevelopmentIndicators.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/skills/humanDevelopmentIndicators.data.ts)

[multidimensionalPoverty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/povertyAndWellbeing/skills/multidimensionalPoverty.data.ts)

[structuralChange.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/structuralChange.data.ts)

[sectoralEconomicStructure.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/sectoralEconomicStructure.data.ts)

[structuralTransformation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/structuralTransformation.data.ts)

[technologicalCatchUp.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/structuralChange/skills/technologicalCatchUp.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende cómo los países aprenden de tecnologías desarrolladas en otros lugares.

### Economía digital

Groups: 3 · Skills: 9

[digitalEconomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalEconomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Digital products and platforms change reproduction costs, market access, competition, and demand for labor. The focus is their economic mechanisms, not software implementation.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo los productos y las plataformas digitales transforman las empresas y los mercados.

#### Productos digitales

Skills: 3

[digitalProducts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalProducts/digitalProducts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information goods often involve large initial costs and low costs of reproduction, enabling different business models.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre por qué crear productos digitales puede ser costoso, pero copiarlos resulta barato.

##### Economía de los datos personales

[economicsOfPersonalData.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/digitalProducts/skills/economicsOfPersonalData.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate exchanges of personal data for services, information asymmetry, and the economic value of privacy.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora las compensaciones económicas ocultas de servicios financiados con datos personales.

### Producción y emprendimiento

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[productionAndEntrepreneurship.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionAndEntrepreneurship.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Creating value combines resources, technology, organization, and risk. This domain studies firms' production decisions and the sustainability of their operations.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo las empresas transforman recursos e ideas en productos y servicios.

#### Emprendimiento y contabilidad

Skills: 4

[entrepreneurshipAndAccounting.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A new business requires testing the value offered, organizing resources, and analyzing its financial results.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende qué hace económicamente viable una idea empresarial.

##### Flujo de caja empresarial

[businessCashFlow.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting/skills/businessCashFlow.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Track receipts and payments over time and detect liquidity needs even when accounting reports show a profit.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué una empresa rentable puede quedarse sin efectivo.

##### Modelo de negocio

[businessModel.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting/skills/businessModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect the value created, customers served, revenue streams, and main costs into a coherent account of how a business operates.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explica cómo una empresa crea valor y genera ingresos.

##### Ingresos, costos y ganancias empresariales

[businessRevenueCostsAndProfit.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting/skills/businessRevenueCostsAndProfit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret turnover, expenses, and operating results without confusing profitability with available cash.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue ingresos, gastos, beneficios y dinero disponible.

##### Oportunidad emprendedora

[entrepreneurialOpportunity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/entrepreneurshipAndAccounting/skills/entrepreneurialOpportunity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an unmet need, potential customers, necessary resources, and risks involved in realizing a business idea.

**User-friendly description (es):** Identifica qué hace prometedora o arriesgada una oportunidad de negocio.

#### Decisiones y gestión de la empresa

Skills: 2

[firmDecisionMakingAndManagement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/firmDecisionMakingAndManagement/firmDecisionMakingAndManagement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The incentives and decisions of owners, managers, and workers shape a firm's organization and production; competitive market structure is analyzed separately.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo las personas de una empresa toman decisiones económicas.

##### Maximización de beneficios de la empresa

[firmProfitMaximization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/firmDecisionMakingAndManagement/skills/firmProfitMaximization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate output decisions using the relationship between marginal revenue and marginal cost in a specified model.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo una empresa elige su producción para aumentar sus ganancias.

##### Propietarios, gerentes y trabajadores

[ownersManagersAndWorkers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/firmDecisionMakingAndManagement/skills/ownersManagersAndWorkers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how decision rights and incentives are distributed among owners, managers, and workers whose goals and information may differ.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce que estos grupos pueden tener prioridades diferentes.

#### Costos y escala de producción

Skills: 5

[productionCostsAndScale.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/productionCostsAndScale.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Economic production decisions account for opportunity costs, time horizons, and how unit costs change with output.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo cambian los costos cuando varía la escala empresarial.

##### Costos medios de producción

[averageProductionCosts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/averageProductionCosts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Calculate cost per unit of output and explain how it depends on scale and the composition of costs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Calcula el costo promedio de producir una unidad.

##### Beneficio económico

[economicProfit.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/economicProfit.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate a firm's result after both explicit expenditures and implicit opportunity costs, distinguishing economic from accounting profit.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué el beneficio económico considera más que los gastos registrados.

##### Economías de escala

[economiesOfScale.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/economiesOfScale.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine how sustained increases in production scale may lower or raise average costs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo producir a mayor escala puede cambiar el costo unitario.

##### Costos fijos y variables

[fixedAndVariableCosts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/fixedAndVariableCosts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish costs that do not depend on output over a stated time horizon from those that vary with production.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue costos constantes y costos que aumentan con la producción.

##### Costo marginal de producción

[marginalProductionCost.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/skills/marginalProductionCost.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine the additional cost of producing the next unit and use it to analyze production decisions.

**User-friendly description (es):** Calcula cuánto cuesta producir una unidad adicional.

#### Recursos productivos y tecnología

Skills: 4

[productiveResourcesAndTechnology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/productiveResourcesAndTechnology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Labor, capital, land, knowledge, and methods of production determine output possibilities and the substitution of productive inputs.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo los recursos y la tecnología afectan lo que las empresas pueden producir.

##### Rendimientos marginales decrecientes

[diminishingMarginalReturns.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/diminishingMarginalReturns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze changes in additional output when one variable input increases while other inputs and technology are fixed; distinguish marginal product from total output.

**User-friendly description (es):** Comprende por qué añadir más de un insumo puede acabar generando menos producto extra.

##### Factores de producción

[factorsOfProduction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/factorsOfProduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify resources by their roles in creating goods and services without confusing financial capital with physical capital.

**User-friendly description (es):** Reconoce los distintos recursos necesarios para producir bienes y servicios.

##### Función de producción

[productionFunction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/productionFunction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate feasible output to quantities of inputs and technological capability within a specified model.

**User-friendly description (es):** Relaciona insumos y tecnología de una empresa con su producción posible.

##### Productividad

[productivity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productiveResourcesAndTechnology/skills/productivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Measure output relative to a production input and distinguish labor productivity from total factor productivity.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cuánto se produce con los recursos utilizados.
